sample_unit: models (crowdsourced teams) evaluated on prospectively collected patient cohort
models_evaluated: 25 crowdsourced all-cause mortality prediction models (top team AUROC 0.947)

links.outcome: Model accuracy differences across race and gender subpopulations
links.effect: Post hoc analysis revealed that models differ in accuracy on subpopulations, delineated by race or gender, even when trained on the same data.
links.quote: Post hoc analysis after the challenge revealed that models differ in accuracy on subpopulations, delineated by race or gender, even when they are trained on the same data.

unlisted_practices: Crowdsourced community challenge with Model-to-Data framework to benchmark models on prospectively collected health system data

screen.reason: Empirical community benchmark challenge evaluating 25 crowdsourced predictive risk models for all-cause mortality on prospective EHR data, including subpopulation equity/disparity analysis.
